summary: WI-05c bundles two independently testable behaviors: (1) ending-variant simulation rules (decision branches to 2+ endings, one-shot trigger, credits flag, restart) and (2) the save-schema extension (version bump, trivial migration, pre-descent/post-trigger autosave points). The save migration is testable in isolation (load pre-extension save, verify defaults) without any ending logic; the ending branching is testable with in-memory state without the save system. This exceeds the one-behavior limit. Suggested split boundary: WI-05c keeps ending variants (simulation rules, headless scenario tests) and carries AC-end-variants as final proof owner; a new WI-05d owns the save-schema extension (save system, headless scenario tests), depends on WI-05b, and provides the milestone autosave points that WI-05c's integration scenario consumes. WI-05c then also depends on WI-05d for the full save-reload proof.
